answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 36788 Country: India Title: Can we use credit card for any purchase and pay the credit amount before the due date Question: Can we use credit card for any purchase and pay the credit amount before the due date? Answer ID: 36788 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 370/328/D=1433) It is lawful to use credit card to buy goods provided the card holder already has amount in his account, so that the company which issues the card could receive its debt from his account or in case of no amount but the payment of the bills is paid in fixed times so that no interest is incurred on it, because it is haram to pay interest. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
